title: Token-Aware Joint Optimization for Ground-LEO Collaborative Multimodal AIGC Inference: simulation code and calibration data
description: Simulation code, Qwen3-VL profile-calibration pipeline, and the sweep outputs used in the IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology correspondence 'Token-Aware Joint Optimization for Ground-LEO Collaborative Multimodal AIGC Inference'. Includes the closed-form per-user solutions, the dual decomposition with certified stopping, the four baselines, and the calibrated rate-distortion profiles.
